# Skill routers — read this first, not MANIFEST.json

**Generated by `node scripts/build-skill-routers.mjs` — do not edit.**

Discovery is two-tier on purpose. Reading the full manifest costs ~14,851 tokens across
147 entries and grows with every skill added, so a good new skill makes every unrelated task
more expensive. Read the six lines below, open the ONE namespace that matches, then load the skill.

| [`engineering`](engineering.md) | Backend, data modelling, refactoring, debugging, documentation — how the thing is built | 28 |
| [`frontend-design`](frontend-design.md) | UI, visual design, component systems, accessibility — what the user sees | 26 |
| [`quality-security`](quality-security.md) | Testing, review, auth, secrets, compliance — what stops it shipping broken | 28 |
| [`ai-agents`](ai-agents.md) | LLM applications, agents, retrieval, prompts, tools — the AI layer itself | 27 |
| [`ops-delivery`](ops-delivery.md) | Deploy, CI, git workflow, jobs, ticketing — running it in production | 21 |
| [`business-growth`](business-growth.md) | Pricing, metrics, market, positioning, copy, conversion — why anyone pays | 17 |

147 skills total. `MANIFEST.json` remains the exhaustive index and is what
`npm run check:skills-manifest` verifies; it is not the place to start a lookup.
